control-value.description: The one value a control holds, the empty string while it holds none.

lf-select.description: One choice from a dropdown, drawn by Web Awesome's select, a component that knows nothing of Leaf. Write the library's `wa-select` inside it, with a `wa-option` for each choice, and put it in an `lf-group` whose label asks the question. Write a starting choice as this element's `value`.
lf-select.example: <lf-group id="plan" label="Which plan?"><lf-select id="plan-choice"><wa-select placeholder="Choose a plan"><wa-option value="starter">Starter</wa-option><wa-option value="team">Team</wa-option></wa-select></lf-select></lf-group>

lf-chosen.description: The choice another widget holds, as words. Set `for` to the id of a widget that holds a `control-value`.

lf-level.description: A level on a scale, set on a range the element holds, which says `level-change` at every change of its value, a script's set included.
